name: 78641 · Leander, TX
findings: ZIP 78641 (Leander) has 178 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78641 (Leander) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78641 (Leander) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
